batting.name: JR Hopes
batting.dismissal: c PA Patel b M Ntini

batting.name: KC Sangakkara
batting.dismissal: c PA Patel b MS Gony

batting.name: Yuvraj Singh
batting.dismissal: c M Muralitharan b MS Gony

batting.name: DPMD Jayawardene
batting.dismissal: c PA Patel b JA Morkel

batting.name: WA Mota
batting.dismissal: c SK Raina b JA Morkel

batting.name: S Vidyut
batting.dismissal: c WA Mota b IK Pathan

balls.text: full and outside off, tries to loft but misses, they go through for a bye, Parthiv misses again and they end with some sort of a total to fight with
full-toss this time, in the slot for Powar, hammers that through midwicket, Balaji isn't going to get away with these freebies, Powar is the highest scorer of the innings

that's a short-arm jab, too short that, he shuffles a bit towards leg, swivels around and blasts that through midwicket for another four, Dhoni isn't happy, Balaji has had a poor day but got away mostly
slower one and he's thwacked that, stands tall and pulls away hard, top-edge that time but soaring towards midwicket, one-bounce into the fence, 100 up
and another jump down the track, he misses the swat again, goes through to the keeper and they get a bye, Parthiv misses the stumps this time

jumps down the track and misses, thinks of running a bye, Parthiv rolls the ball to the stumps and that's really close, goes to the third umpire but he's just in, an inch in, what a reckless run he tried there. They have totally panicked today.

Oh you cracker! Suresh Raina has pulled off a peach of a catch at long-off, lofted straight, that was high on the bat and ballooned up towards no-man's land but Raina is quick, sprints towards it, puts in the dive and plucks out a low chance, they're not letting up here
worked away to deep backward square leg, he looks for another big one down the ground but isn't in the slot

he's connected that, stands in his normal position, sees the ball full and a bit wide, in the slot actually, gets his front leg out of the way, his eyes light up and he's thunders that way over extra cover for six, biggie
tries to swat a good-length ball over midwicket again, under-edge to long-on, that wasn't middled at all
Streaky four this time, full and angling in, he looks to slog that over midwicket but the inside edge runs away past the short fine leg for four, Morkel holds his head in anguish
backs off and strikes a full one crisply through extra cover for a couple
full and hammered one back, the bowler tries to take a one-handed catch but that was racing, past the umpire but the long-off mops up
and another full toss, this is bizarre from Balaji, and even more bizarre from the batsmen, pushed without much timing to long-on
another full toss, could have gone anywhere but pushed towards long-on
cracked straight to Badrinath at point but a slight misfield allows them to take one, Balaji has actually got away with a few wide ones and full tosses
more bounce, he tries to carve that over the slips but can't make contact

What an attempt from Murali! Full toss and that's lofted towards midwicket, Murali sprints back from midwicket and nearly pulls off a stunner, judges it well but can't latch onto to it in the end, that would have been a sensational catch
angled into the batsman, pushed to the on side for a quick one
down the track again, bit of width, takes it on the full and cracks it hard through cover, only a single, though
that's moved away from him, tries to glide past the keeper but beaten by the seam movement
135.5kph, that was full, Powar jumped down the track but made thatinto a yorker-length ball and missed, maybe standing at the crease might have made things easier
short again, stands back and swats it through square leg, that was a tennis shot almost, smash down the line, that was racing away
more short of a length, hitting the wicket hard, he tries to glide to third man but can't make allowance for the bounce, it's been their problem all day
85.3kph, straight too, defended back to the bowler, fine end to his spell here
full on the leg stump, spinning away, that's too wide
waits on that one, glided towards third man but can't beat the fielder in the infield
he thinks of jumping down the track but that was flatter, checks his shot and plays it back
bit of turn, he's on the back foot and tapping towards cover
dances down the track and tries to loft straight, no timing and that's gone to long-on
flighted again, you can afford to with this total, pushed watchfully through extra cover
good-length ball but too wide again, Powar goes for a mighty heave but can't make contact, the extra zip has got to all the batsmen here
too wide, Powar tries to slash but can't get to it, that was there to be struck for four, the grimace suggests as much
tapped to deep point, confidently done, surprisingly they don't think of a taking a second, saying yes and no, before just scraping home, too easy a run this
punched ferociously, off the back-foot, to the right of mid-off and that's racing away, these runs are vital
124.5kph, full and moving a bit, patted to mid-on
width on offer, he tries to flay that but misses, too far away from the body
tapped to the off side
turned away from outside off to the leg side, straight to the fielder

you little beauty! tossed up the straighter one, Chawla tries to swing it away to the leg side but is completely foxed by the flight, it's fullish and beats the wild swing, the stumps are disturbed and Murali has the 1000 Watt smile to celebrate
defended to the off side

and nearly another run-out. This is panic and this is needless. Mota sweeps, the backward square leg misfields and he looks for two but Chawla is not interested, the throw is into the keeper and Parthiv's throw to the bowler is wide, that could have been another mess up.
tossed up on middle and off, PIyush backs off and tries to loft over long-off but can't get the elevation, driven to long-off
short again, that's been the plan and they've implemented it wonderfully, pulled to fine leg but only a single
cut away to deep point
on his toes and dropping the ball down towards the covers

short and wide, cut away but Gony is prowling there, another poor bit of running, more panic, Gony lets out a good throw but Balaji doesn't collect that, might have been another run-out, this is surely stage fright
123.4kph, short of a length, patted to cover but the fielder is there
and short of a length again, the plan is clear - bend your back and get bounce. Tapped to the off side for a single
digs it in again, punched on his toes to third man
and another streaky one, short and angling outside off, he pulls but can only manage a top edge over the slip for four, he was no way in control of that
short and well directed again, no letting up from Morkel, Piyush needs to duck under it
135kph, full and pushed to midwicket
slightly short, angling away from the left-hander, drops his bat
good bounce again, bending his back and hitting the deck, bit of width and it's steered to third man
turned away towards square for a couple, lots of nervous energy around there

another near mess up, Punjab are in disarray here, leading edge from Piyush, just pops over short extra cover, the throw is wide and they think of taking the over-throw, Dhoni sees the misunderstanding, fires one to the bowler but Murali can't collect it in time and whip the bails, that would have been another run-out
patted to gully but no run too, Chennai giving nothing away
sharp offbreak, pitched on middle and turns away, shoulders arms
swept away to fine leg, man in place for the top edge
doosra this time, Mota is a handy domestic batsman in the lower order but wouldn't have faced anything so good, can't read that one
136kph, short and straight, ducks under it

he's dangled the carrot and Mahela is lured straight into the trap, not too short, a bit of width, Mahela tries to be too cute by steering that to third man but a meaty edge goes at a comfortable height to Parthiv, the wheels are coming off here, Chennai on a roll
full and on off, driven sweetly to mid-on but they can't get anything from that
bit of width, steered towards third man

another close one, almost one more run-out, pushed back to the bowler and Mota thinks of a single (absolutely no chance for a run there), Morkel throws it back but it misses the stumps, would have been gone if that had hit
bounce straight away, short of a length and the batsman needs to get on his toes to pat it down the ground
pushed to cover, can't find the gap
good-length ball outside off, driven back to the bowler, sweet timing
bit of width and he's tapped that effortlessly through backward point for four, Ntini can't get there this time, fine shot, can Mahela pull the chestnuts out of the fire?
super ball, cuts Mahela in half, seam movement from outside off to middle, Parthiv appeals but there was no bat there

what a mess up! irfan Pathan has attempted a reckless third run and is stranded, here's what happened: Mahela drives on the up towards backward point and that appeared to be racing away for four, Ntini, at third man, lets out a diving stop, makes sure the ball is in the field as he tumbles over the rope and gets up to retrieve it, Irfan meanwhile has thought of a third but Ntini is quick enough to throw it back to the bowler's end, Gony does the rest and Pathan can only give a clueless expression. Jayawardene had taken off for the third, by the way. But suddenly stopped. Pathan didn't see that. Whodunnit?
130.9kph, back of a length, angling away a shade, pushed to cover and they scamper through
pushed to mid-on, just 2 runs in the last 11 balls, pressure, pressure

huge appeal but Asad Rauf says no, short of a length, angling into middle and leg, big appeal for lbw, Kapugedera takes a sharp catch to appeal for a catch as well, that pitched outside leg and didn't hit the bat, the end result of all this was a dot, Chennai won't mind such drama if every ball is a dot
firm drive but straight to the fielder again, four fielders very close in at point and cover, hardly a gap to find there
and some more hesitation, short of a length, pushed to cover and they think of a suicidal single, decide against it at just the right time
wide of the stumps again, Mahela drives away from the body and steers it to third man, that was an edgy shot
delivering from wide of the crease, no angle into the batsman, too wide outside off, no wide given strangely
maiden from Gony, his third maiden in the tournament, full and outside off, punched to point, giving nothing away here
132kph, short and he tries to pull, nobody is connecting the pull today, misses that one
no room to play with there, short of a length and right at his body, pushed to the on side, there's nothing much you can do with those
full and driven straight to mid-off, good stride forward from Irfan
punched tentatively to the cover region, short of a length again, the Chennai bowlers have hardly given anything away
131kph, lets it go outside off, moving away from the left-hander but a bit too wide outside off
straight again, good-length and on middle, turned away behind square for an easy single

bowled 'im, he's gone for the pull, has been beaten by pace again and played onto his stumps, that's a huge wicket, Ntini goes into an aeroplane celebration, Marsh had just got a four and he's tried to pull here, he hasn't been comfortable with pulling through this innings, pays the price here, Chennai well and truly bossing this game now

the length is slightly fuller and Marsh has latched on, glorious straight drive just past the stumps at the non-striker's end, nobody is going to stop that, racing away, is that the shot that will get him into the mood?
straight again, short of a length, pushed back to the bowler
beaten for pace again, Marsh hasn't got into his stride here, that is delivered from closer to the non-striker's end and the batsman can't get onto it quickly enough
136kph, straight again, good-length ball and offers no width at all, this is percentage bowling, they know Marsh's ability to cut and pull
on the pads and he's turned that off his hips, firmly pushed to deep square leg
good-length this time, pushed to the leg side and they manage a quick single

Yuvraj is gone now, what a catch from Murali, slightly short and he's rocked back to pull it ferociously, that was bulleting through midwicket but Murali has intercepted that brilliantly, Gony is ecstatic and Murali is prancing around, this is surely trouble for Punjab.
yorker-length ball that, outside off and caught Yuvraj napping, he's tried to drive but is too late on it, Gony is from Punjab remember, Yuvraj's team-mate at the Ranji level
132kph, full and outside off, he pushes hard but doesn't get the timing, can't beat the field
bit of bounce off a good length, turned away to short midwicket but no run there
that's quick and he's hit on the body, goes for the pull again (remember he's grown up at the WACA in Perth) but is hit on the body, trickles away to the slips, surely beaten for pace again
cramped for room, checks his push to mid-off
another streaky shot, this time an inside edge to a short-of-a-length ball, races past the stumps to fine leg, the Punjab dug-out is there and are they relieved.
punched towards midwicket and that's a good stop by Vidyut, keeps them down to a single
that might have been close, pushed to mid-off and they take Murali on again, could have been close but Marsh looked in control, Murali misses anyway

short and pulled away, top-edge soars straight behind the keeper, straight towards long-stop for a six, S Anirudha is standing behind the boundary with drinks and even he can't catch that, Marsh was beaten by the pace but he's got a big one
straight and cramps him for room, good line this from Gony, glided to third man for an easy single, he appeared to be setting himself for the loft over the infield but adjusted after seeing the line
131.3kph, short of a length, just outside off, punched to the off side and they take off
full and moving away a shade, driven hard towards extra cover but can't beat the field
driven to mid-off and Balaji mis-fields, allowing them a second run
down the leg side, he tries to turn that away but it's wide

that's another big one! Sangakkara has walked there. Angling away from the left-hander and only a half-hearted appeal from Gony, nothing from Parthiv behind the stumps but the batsman walks. Is this his Gilchrist moment? Semi-final of a big tournament, he's edged to the keeper and walked. What a start for the Super Kings.
127.9kph, short of a length, outside off, pushed firmly towards mid-off
good-length ball outside off, pushed to cover, well in control of that one, that typical unhurried Marsh
pushed to cover and they scamper through, Murali lets rip a direct hit from wide of mid-off but it deflects away for a couple of over-throws, Sangakkara was safely in when the throw came in
119kph, full and straight, pushed firmly back but straight to the bowler, bit of movement after pitching there too

that's gone, Ntini strikes with a wide one, Hopes slashes hard at a wide one but that's moving away from the right-hander, thick top-edge goes at an easy height to Parthiv, they're cock-a-hoop, Ntini would admit that was a poor ball but it's produced a wicket. Chennai won't complain.
full and outside off, angling in from wide of the crease, pushed back firmly to the bowler, good one-handed stop from Ntini
bit of movement, seaming away from leg to middle, Marsh fends at it and a thickish edge runs away to third man, he ensured he took his bottom hand off in the last moment
88.3kph, turns from middle to leg, that's big spin already, drifts down leg but no wide called
swept away and another super effort, this time from Albie Morkel at fine leg, that was running away to the fence but he kept them down to a couple
pushes him back and forces a watchful push to the on side, Raina puts in a good save
on the pads and flicked away, good athletic stop from Vidyut at short fine leg that keeps them to a single
tossed up on middle and leg, pushed to the off side, slightly slower from Murali
one slip in place but Marsh has smacked a full one through cover, sweet timing and that's racing away

superbly chipped past mid-off for a four and it's all over, Chennai's players are all in the middle congratulating Raina and Parthiv, it's been a fantastic day for them and they've routed Punjab, who came into this game as favourites. Yuvraj is dejected but he will know that they brought it upon themselves.
flighted on off, swept to fine leg for a single
turned away to square leg for a single, they're closing in now
and that's fifty for Raina, he's not to the pitch of the ball that time but goes through with the shot anyway, over extra cover and that's four all the way, what a shot that was
Raina is laying into Chawla here, tossed up on off and he's slog swept that over midwicket for his fourth six, these are rollicking sixes here but he's doing it with ease
full and on the pads, driven confidently through midwicket
135kph, yorker length and on middle, turned away to square leg for a single, fifty comes up, his second of the tournament
punched towards mid-off
132.6kph, short and outside off, wide called, Sangakkara is clapping again, he's in a generous mood today (especially after the decision to walk)
driven neatly through the covers
short and bouncing a bit extra, he tries to glide through to third man but can't get it, bit too much zip

and another! Raina is in six mode, short of a length and he's backed away and pulled that way over midwicket into the crowd, sweet sound of bat on ball, crunched away with a flat bat, everyone has struggled to pull on this pitch, Raina is managing just fine
tossed up and that's been beefed away, slog sweep through deep square leg, nearly carries all the way, one-bounce through for four, whistled through
holds that one back a bit, Raina moves back and pulls away to midwicket
swept away for a quick one
a bit short and that's peppered the point fence, Yuvraj tries to pull off a diving stop but no chance there, that was travelling
worked away to the leg side
shuffles across and tries to sweep, there was an appeal there but not give, looked close
tossed up on middle, driven forcefully down the ground, Powar is slightly wide at long-on and needs to put in a dive to stop that, sweetly timed again
bit too short again, pulled away off the back foot towards midwicket
worked away to fine leg, easily done
good spin there, tries to cut but is beaten
driven to extra cover, good stop from Yuvraj, tries to get the direct hit in but that gets only the non-striker's bat
a bit short, cut away efficiently through point

Huge! That's one of the biggest sixes ever hit at the Wankhede, soars over the roof and outside towards Churchgate station, time to take the Borivalli fast for that one, short and that's pulled away with immense power, gets the elevation and the distance, Raina in demolition mode here
short and spanked that ferociously, quick swivel and he's struck that well, straight to the fielder, though, Hopes trips on his follow through
128kph, short one directed on the body, gets off the ground and tapped towards the on side, quick one there
cramped for room, angles the bat towards third man for a single
slashes outside off but done in by the extra bounce, through to the keeper

that's emphatic, what a way to bring up the 50-run partnership, takes a stride forward, backs away a bit and cracks it hard over mid-on for four, that was struck with immense power, pocket-dynamo this fellow
googly to finish the over, Raina tries to steer it at the last moment but is beaten
turned to short fine leg and "no" is the loud call
flicked to backward square leg
pushed back hard to the bowler, was made to hurry on that
glided to third man, fine stop from Marsh and keeps them down to one
Now that's a close shave, Raina down the crease and tries to smash it to the on side, can't make contact and there's a misunderstanding, throw from short third man is accurate but Raina is just in
short of a length, straight too, pushed back down the pitch
bit of bounce and jumps to steer it to third man, glum faces all around the fielding unit, what a stage to freeze
driven to deep cover, easy single there
gets the extra width this time, slashes hard and that's carved towards backward point for four, Powar can't get there from third man
cut away towards point, straight to the fielder
good-length ball to start with, tries to angle it away, cut away off the back foot, easily done, elegantly too, gets a quick one
glided to third man for a single
135.9kph, full and outside off, tapped towards mid-off and they take off
tapped to the off side and Parthiv wants the single, Raina says no but that was an easy run, Parthiv even stands mid pitch and shouts at Raina for declining that before getting back comfortably
135kph, full and outside off, pushed watchfully, under-edge trickles back to the keeper
turned away to square leg, waited on that one and jumped to flick it away
slap, he's got that straight off the screws, short ball and he's backed away and thundered that with a flat bat over long-on, what a shot
that hurried through a bit, on the back foot and pulling but he needs to get through the shot quickly
and another, bit too short, bit too slow, cut away to deep point, he needs to fizz them through
73kph, on the back foot and punching away hard to cover, too slow for them here
waits on that, the drifter it seems, cuts hard towards deep point, the length is a bit too short from Powar
more flight, slower and outside off, he looks for a weird sweep by walking across but is beaten, that was a strange shot, could have played on
generous flight from Powar, pitched outside off and turns away, surely a wide
slower and tossed up, swept hard but that was perilously close to Marsh, he leapt off the ground and could only manage to get his fingertips to it, raced away for four
rocking back, tapped to cover, confidently done

tucked away to square leg, they think of a single, Mota gets the direct hit but Parthiv is well back, no need to refer that to the third umpire (though he did), that's pretty shoddy umpiring, no way was that going to be out
full and outside off, punched towards mid-off, they take off for a quick one and Yuvraj misfields that one
tapped to cover, watchfully done

short and he's top-edged that, nervy phase this, he was no way in control of that, flies away over the keeper for four, nearly a six there, one-bounce four that, Asad Rauf seems totally disinterested with the goings on. He's an umpire, of course, not a fan.
good-length ball, angling away, pushed to cover, watchfully done
turned away to short midwicket, on the jump again
short this time, you might have expected more of that after what the Chennai bowlers did, forced him to jump and push to point, loose hands there
130.4kph, edgy drive that, tries to punch through the covers but a thick edge flies towards third man
full and outside off, spanked through to mid-off but Yuvraj stops that, they decide against a single
full and shaping away a bit, strikes the outside of the bat towards cover
slower one this time but Parthiv has dealt with disdain, it's full and he's stood upright and peppered that straight down the ground for four, no need to run for that one, stand and admire
crack! a bit short and Raina spotted that early, cut away with some wonderful timing, past the infield for four
64.9kph, he saw him coming down the track and had to adjust to one that was flat and quick, adjusts his shot and glides away to third man, past the fielder for four
another slow one, outside leg, swept away but not much timing
charges down the track and tries to belt that over midwicket, thick under-edge that dribbles to midwicket, fielder there mops up
flighted on leg, turning away, defended back to the bowler, huge roars for Powar
tossed up, bit of turn but some slow turn only, cut away to cover but straight to the fielder
more swing, prodigious this time, starts from off and moves alarmingly away, Raina lets it go but Pathan knows that it would have put some doubts into the batsman
full again, not much swing this time, punched to mid-on and they take off, VRV is a bit slow and they scamper through
on the leg stump, swinging in a shade, tries to flick but rapped on the pads then
too wide, more swing too, that was way too outside off, strangely Sangakkara is clapping for that
129.8kph, full and outside off, pushed to midwicket

strike one! Pathan has drawn first blood, short and he's in no position to play the pull, feet rooted to the crease and trying to swat through midwicket, top-edge flies high and it taken by Mota at square leg, Yuvraj is pumped up and Irfan too.
swing again, full and moving away, driven towards mid-off, he takes an initial step forward and looks for width, not much on that occasion
punched back to the bowler, full and in the slot but he can't get the placement
full and too wide outside off, Parthiv needs two bats to get to that, that was too wide for comfort
full and a bit of movement away from the left-hander, tapped towards mid-off
136.7kph, too straight and tucked behind square for a single, loud "No" from Parthiv as they consider a second
cramps him for room here, short of a length and jagging back in, that's a better length, rapped on the pads but too high for an lbw
too far down the leg side again, Sreesanth is bowling a right-hander's line here, someone please send for his spectacles, clipped straight to fine leg

sliding down the pads, full and swinging into the let-hander, clipped away effortlessly to square leg for four, Pathan tries to cut it off from fine leg but can't get there, lots of wrist from Parthiv there
full and shaping away a bit, pushed to extra cover
cracked away meatily, takes a stride and carves that past backward point for four, well in control of that
full and driven sweetly, fine bit of fielding from Yuvraj at mid-off, keeps them down to a single, that was racing through
swinging outside off, bit too short this time, flashed in the air but that's past point, Vidyut will go for any width, they should have known that by now
back of a length, steered to third man
that's some good swing straight away, pitches short of a length and shaping away, Parthiv is squared up
